decision: Selected the centroid of Harris County parcel 1159570000006 (owner Verizon Data Centers I LLC, mailed to 1 Lagoon Dr, Redwood City CA; situs 1515 Aldine Meadows Rd, Houston 77032; 6.011 geodesic acres; year built 1999 in the snapshot) as the campus locator for Equinix HO1. Both the TxGIO 9-1-1 address point for 1515 Aldine Meadows Rd and the map point embedded in Equinix's own HO1 page fall inside it. It locates the HO1 property, not the storage room being converted, the new data hall or the mechanical yard.

computed.crs: EPSG:4326 as served (wkid 4326); areas and distances on the WGS84 ellipsoid (pyproj Geod)

identity_bridge: TDLR TABS2027004299 (registered 2026-10-23): project 'Equinix', facility 'Equinix Houston Renovation', 1515 Aldine Meadows Drive, Houston 77032, Harris County; owner Equinix LLC, 1 Lagoon Drive, Redwood City, California.
TDLR TABS address search for 1515 Aldine Meadows also lists the closed 2017 project EABPRJB8806660 'EQUINIX HO1-2 FOH', facility 'EQUINIX HO1'.
Equinix's HO1 page (Internet Archive copy of 3 October 2026) gives HO1's address as 1515 Aldine Meadows Road, Houston, TX 77032, with an embedded map point that falls inside the selected parcel.

Harris Appraisal District data in the TxGIO parcel layer: parcel 1159570000006, situs 1515 Aldine Meadows Rd, owner Verizon Data Centers I LLC, mailed to 1 Lagoon Dr, Redwood City CA 94065, the street address the TABS registration gives for owner Equinix LLC.
alternatives_rejected: Union of parcels 1159570000006 and 1159570000002 (both Verizon Data Centers I LLC, situs 1515 Aldine Meadows Rd): its centroid falls in 1159570000002, which has no year built in the snapshot, and lies outside the parcel holding both reference points; the union is recorded here as context only.
The TxGIO 9-1-1 address point alone: it is an address reference, 13.5 m from the selected centroid.
The Equinix page map point alone: an operator-published marker without stated accuracy; used only as an identity check.
Census or commercial geocoders, OpenStreetMap, Nominatim and Overpass: not used.

consistency_checks.privacy: the envelope capture lists private-individual owners of neighbouring parcels; none is restated here
